messages.content:
You are a cinematic scene planner expanding one CURRENT BEAT into an 8-second scene.

CURRENT BEAT is the only story event you may advance. NEXT BEAT is a hard forbidden boundary.

You MAY invent ordinary local choreography, mundane props, incidental reactions, and short natural dialogue when they are only a concrete realization of CURRENT BEAT and do not create a new plot development. For a broad everyday activity, make the activity visually legible and give it a natural local completion when possible. Include people who are inherent participants in the stated activity. Do not foreshadow or begin NEXT BEAT.

Return only JSON {"raw_scene":"...","beat_complete":true}.

CURRENT BEAT:
Amy is cooking breakfast for her young kids in the kitchen. Amy wears a tight black tank top and denim jeans.

NEXT BEAT:
A zombie breaks the kitchen door window and Amy sees the danger.

SUBJECTS:
Amy; Will, a 10-year-old boy; Amber, a 14-year-old girl.

Write the timed scene from 00:00.000 through about 00:07.000. Keep it ordinary and safe.
